title: fix(ci): the Test aggregator re-reads a present shard the jobs API answered with no conclusion (objectui#10931)
body:
Fixes #10931
Clause-②: no — repairs an existing CI gate's read of the jobs API; no published contract, key, export or flag changes

## What went wrong

merge_group run `36042402511` (PR objectui#10316) got ejected from the merge queue even though all eight `Test (shard N/8)` jobs were green. The `Test` aggregator job (`107781652735`) printed this reading in its own log (fetched through the Actions job-log API):

```text
18:47:10.56Z  needs.test.result (the matrix rollup this gate deliberately does NOT trust) = success
18:47:14.07Z  read 16 job(s) from this run; expecting 8 test shard(s)
                success x7, and: "no conclusion  Test (shard 6/8)"
```

## Mechanism, measured

- **H1 (the read): confirmed.** `evaluate` stores a non-string `conclusion` as null and counts a present shard with a null conclusion as not-success. That is what the log line shows.
- **H2 (lag vs pagination vs `filter=latest`): pagination and `filter=latest` are ruled out. The fix rests on a stale per-job record.**
  - Pagination is ruled out. The read printed `read 16 job(s)`. The same attempt endpoint answers `total_count` 16 today, and `fetchRunJobs()` asks for 100 per page, so everything fits on one page.
  - `filter=latest` is ruled out. `fetchRunJobs()` never sends it. It reads `/actions/runs/{id}/attempts/{n}/jobs`, which is scoped to one attempt, and this run has `run_attempt` 1.
  - That leaves one job's record served stale. Shard 6/8 has `completed_at` 18:46:21Z, and it read as null at least 49 s later (the fetch ran between 18:47:10.56Z and 18:47:14.07Z). Shards 1/8 (completed 18:46:56Z) and 4/8 (completed 18:47:02Z) finished **later** and still read `success`. In the same step, the orchestrator's `needs.test.result` printed `success`. The same endpoint answers `success` for 6/8 today. So this is not a uniform lag ordered by completion time. The jobs API served one job without its conclusion for a while.
  - NOT MEASURED: how long the staleness lasts. The log gives only a lower bound of 49 s, and the Actions log blob host is unreachable from this container. The job-log API returned the aggregator's log.
- **Frequency census (taken 2026-09-29, by hand, not re-derived by anything in this PR).** I read every `CI` run with `status=failure` created since `eb1c9f9d2` (2026-09-20T14:31:12Z): 49 runs (38 pull_request, 7 merge_group, 4 push). The control run `36042402511` is among them. The aggregator failed in all 45 non-push runs. In 44 of them the annotation names a shard whose conclusion is still non-success today, so those were real failures. Exactly one names `(no conclusion)`: this run. The whole window had 588 merge_group and 954 pull_request `CI` runs. The largest job list per attempt across the 45 was 16.

## The fix

`scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs`:

- `settleReading` judges the first answer. Then it re-reads **only** the shards that the first read found present with a null conclusion. Each re-read is by job id on `GET /repos/{repo}/actions/jobs/{id}` (`fetchJob`, same `actions: read` permission). It re-reads at most `REREAD_LIMIT` (8) times, `REREAD_WAIT_MS` (15 s) apart. The verdict is still `evaluate`'s, over the list with only those records replaced.
- ⛔ It never re-reads a shard that already answered. That covers `failure`, `cancelled`, `timed_out` and `skipped`. The refusal of `skipped` is unchanged.
- ⛔ A shard still null after the last re-read is not success, the same as before.
- An absent shard is matrix drift, not a late answer, so it is not re-read. A reading that doesn't contain the aggregator's own job (`unreadable`) is not re-read either.
- A re-read that answers about a different job (id or name mismatch), or a shard with no id to re-read by, is refused and exits 2. It is never read as a pass.
- The log line for a null shard now prints the job's `status`, and each re-read round names the job id. The next false red will say whether the API reported `completed` with no conclusion, or something else.
- The worst case adds 120 s, and only when a shard stays null through all 8 re-reads. A test pins that inside half of the `test-aggregate` job's own `timeout-minutes` from `ci.yml`. The normal path makes no extra request and has no wait.
- `--fixture` mode does no re-read, because a recorded answer has no later answer.

`ci.yml` is unchanged. The step's inputs did not need to change.

## Tests

`scripts/__tests__/check-test-shard-results.test.ts` pins the recorded run's job table. `scripts/__tests__/fixtures/test-shard-results/run-36042402511-attempt-1.json` is the attempt endpoint's answer today, trimmed to six fields. The as-read view changes exactly one field, the one the log names, and drops that record's `status` rather than guessing it. The new cases:

- The recorded table reproduces the false red: `notSuccess` is `Test (shard 6/8) (no conclusion)`. Control: the settled table is `intact`.
- ⭐ Only job `107777511897` gets re-read, once, and the result is `intact` / exit 0.
- ⛔ A shard that never answers stays `breached` after exactly `REREAD_LIMIT` re-reads.
- A late `failure` counts as a failure.
- `failure` / `cancelled` / `timed_out` / `skipped` get zero re-reads and zero waits.
- With a real failure next to the late shard, only the late shard is re-read and the run stays red.
- An absent shard or an unreadable reading gets no re-read.
- A re-read answering about the wrong job, or a shard with no id, is refused.
- `fetchJob` uses the single-job route, and an HTTP 404 is refused.
- The bound fits inside `ci.yml`'s `timeout-minutes`.

Run at HEAD `5c25cd7`, under the verify lock: `pnpm type-check:scripts && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-test-shard-results.test.ts scripts/__tests__/scripts-type-check.test.ts` gives `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 42 passed (42)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc --listFilesOnly` confirms both changed code files are in the `tsconfig.scripts.json` program.

Live checks against the real API (read-only):

- `main()` on the recorded run (`GITHUB_RUN_ID=36042402511`) prints `all 8 shards reported success` and exits 0.
- `settleReading` on the as-read view, with the real `fetchJob`, logged `re-read 1/8 ... Test (shard 6/8) (job 107777511897, status completed)` and settled `intact` after one live `GET /actions/jobs/107777511897`.

## Ablation (fix committed first; each leg run by `ablation-replace.mjs`, which requires the anchor to hit, checks the write on disk and restores to the HEAD blob)

- **A1: re-read loop disabled** (loop condition replaced with `false && ...`). Anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed. `Tests 5 failed | 21 passed (26)`. I predicted 4. The 5th is the wrong-job refusal case, which also only triggers through a re-read. Restore: blob equals HEAD `86fe49e98caf` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **A2: blanket retry** (every non-success present shard re-read). Anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed. `Tests 3 failed | 23 passed (26)`: the "never re-reads a shard that answered" case, the "real failure beside the late shard" case, and the late-`failure` case (a failure got re-read 8 times). I predicted 2. Restore: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (at HEAD `5c25cd7`, exit captured before any pipe)

- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0, `check-control-bytes: OK`
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`
- `pnpm check:entry-guard`: exit 0
- `pnpm check:pre-install-import-graph`: exit 0, `every non-relative leaf a node builtin` (the aggregator runs without an install)
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, `no changeset is owed` (root `scripts/` only)
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the three paths: `NOT GOVERNED`
- `pnpm lint:root`, narrowed to the two changed code files. This is a narrowed run, not the whole-repo run, and CI runs the full one:
  - Files checked: `calculateConfigForFile` under lint:root's ignore set resolves a config for both. The `.mjs` resolves with **0 rules enabled**, so linting it proves nothing. The test `.ts` has 118 rules. The JSON fixture is outside the lint scope because no config object matches `.json`.
  - Result: `eslint --format json` checked 2 files with 0 errors and 0 warnings, exit 0.
  - Why the narrowing misses nothing: type-aware linting is not enabled (neither resolved config sets `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change lint results for files it doesn't touch. The only importer of the changed module is the changed test file.

## Acceptance notes

- `ci.yml`'s comment on the aggregator step still says the gate is "one `fetch`". It is now one fetch, plus one per null shard per re-read round. I left it alone: the claim allows the workflow to change only if the fix needs new inputs, and it does not. There is no carrier for that edit.
- The fixture keeps the job name `Test (coverage shard ...)` exactly as the API answers it, template text included.
